{{main article|1992 WTA Tour}}

The [[WTA Tier I events]] are part of the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=1992 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1992 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920182953/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1992 |archive-date=2022-09-20 |access-date= |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref><ref name=wot1993>{{cite book|title=The International Tennis Federation : World of Tennis 1993|year=1993|publisher=Collins Willow|location=London|isbn=9780002185080|editor=[[John Barrett (tennis)|John Barrett]]|pages=152, 161–163}}</ref><ref name=wita1993>{{cite book|editor1-last=Bloch Shallouf|editor1-first=Renée|title=1993 Women's Tennis Association Media Guide|date=1993|publisher=[[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]]|location=Miami|page=336}}</ref>
